selector.why: The presence of a trace positive MTB on GeneXpert, necrotizing granulomatous inflammation with a solitary acid-fast bacillus in the toe ulcer biopsy, and contiguous spondylitis with discitis and an epidural/paraspinal collection on MRI of the spine, along with systemic symptoms such as fever, weight loss, and night sweats, strongly support the diagnosis of Tuberculosis.
